name: Custom Shape Engraved Mirror Acrylic Light Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality mirror acrylic, offering a sleek, elegant, and eye-catching illuminated display finish.
    - Designed with a 2-panel mirror acrylic structure, creating a dimensional and modern decorative effect when the light is turned on.
    - Each mirror acrylic panel is made with 3mm thickness, providing a sturdy yet refined construction.
    - Built with metal screw posts and spacers to hold the acrylic panels securely in place while enhancing the layered light box design.
    - Designed with USB-powered lighting, making it convenient for everyday use and easy connection to compatible power sources.
    - Available in Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic options to match different styles and occasions.
    - Combines engraved detailing and soft lighting to create a meaningful personalized keepsake for home or gift display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple size options:
               +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
               +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
               +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    - Metal screw post length: 4.5 cm ~ 1.77 in
    - Metal screw post diameter: 1.2 cm ~ 0.47 in
    - Maximum screws included: 4 screws
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving Technology:
    - This product uses precision engraving technology on mirror acrylic for sharp details and a refined finished look.
    - Available in 2 engraving options:
               +) Engraved on 1 side
               +) Engraved on 2 sides

 

  • Lighting Options:
    - Available in 2 lighting options:
               +) Monochrome
               +) Multicolor
    - Includes separate switch styles depending on the selected light mode.
    - Powered by USB connection for convenient everyday use.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized decorative light box and a meaningful keepsake display.
    - Designed to create a warm and elegant illuminated effect for bedrooms, living rooms, desks, shelves, and bedside tables.
    - Suitable for home décor, memorial gifts, family gifts, appreciation gifts, and personalized room decoration.
    - The layered engraved mirror acrylic panels help create added depth and a stylish glowing appearance.
    - Perfect for displaying heartfelt messages and custom artwork in a unique illuminated format.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for moms, dads, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for family keepsakes, memorial gifts, appreciation gifts, and custom home décor.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who loves elegant personalized decoration with a sentimental touch.
    - Great for shelf décor, desk display, bedside decoration, and commemorative gift giving.
    - Adds a warm, stylish, and memorable touch to any space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Engraved Mirror Acrylic Light Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
